Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator prematurely concluded the task was satisfied after opening an Ensembl page and provided a BioMart/gene-specific URL instead of identifying the canonical file repository that was most relevant in May 2020 (the Broad Institute FTP for canFam3.1). It failed to verify the time-relevant assembly/files across major sources and did not provide a stable file directory link, leading to the incorrect final answer.
